text:
Maria (CS): Quick heads-up — Hightide onboarding: we've seen tail latency spikes on their chat route after ~30k req/day, 95th jumping from 220ms -> 820ms over the last 48h. Renewal convo in 3 weeks. Thinking proactive moves: int8 quant for model shards, model hop to rwd-3-small for non-critical routes, and route-by-latency to Dedicated for warm sessions. Tagging for ops and eng input. :warning:

Ingrid (SE): Def agree we should act before renewal. Proposed plan (short):
- Canary int8 on a small subset of traffic (5%) with preflight evals
- Model hop for "assist-summary" and "autocomplete" to rwd-3-small (same tokenizer)
- Add routing policy: latency-first for sessions flagged as "interactive"
- Enable prefix KV caching for repetitive prompts

Devon (CS): FYI the customer reported a couple of 5xxs yesterday but said UX still mostly ok. They'll be sensitive to any quality regressions — we should capture a few eval prompts from their logs before quant. I'll coordinate and get a small prompt set. :memo:

Sam (Eng-ML): +1. Quick checklist:
1) Eval baseline: run 200 prioritized prompts through both fp16 and int8 qmodel, gather BLEU/ROUGE + human spot-check (we can use the existing eval harness).
2) Canary config snippet (example):
```json
{
  "policy": "percentage_canary",
  "percent": 5,
  "model_map": {
    "assist-summary": "rwd-3-small-int8",
    "default": "rwd-3-large-fp16"
  },
  "fallback": "rwd-3-large-fp16"
}
```
3) Routing snippet for latency-first: (pseudo)
```yaml
route: "interactive"
match: session.interaction == true
action:
  prefer: ["dedicated-pool-us-west", "hosted-lowcost"]
  latency_slo_ms: 300
```

Sam (Eng-ML): Note: before int8 we should add a rollback metric: if quality drift > 0.8% on eval set or customer-flagged errors increase, auto-rollback. We can wire that into the console alerting.

Maria (CS): Devon — once you grab the prompt set can you also attach 3-4 examples where the customer says the output must be verbatim? We'll mark those as "must-pass" during canary. I'll schedule a quick sync with the customer next Tue.

Devon (CS): On it. I'll drop the set into the shared folder and ping you. Also adding a note for sales so renewal team knows we're proactively optimizing.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment initiated for hightide/assist-summary -> rwd-3-small-int8 (canary=5%). Canary ID: canary-2145678901-1 :rocket:

Ingrid (SE): We'll monitor token-level perplexity and the customer's must-pass checks. I'll add a Dashboard tile for "Hightide canary — quality vs baseline" and set alert thresholds.

Maria (CS): Great. Next actions: Devon collect prompts + must-pass examples; Sam run evals and set rollback hooks; Ingrid create dashboard & routing policy draft; I'll brief renewal owner. Thanks team :pray:

Sam (Eng-ML): I'll post eval results into this thread within 24h. If int8 looks good, we can expand to 20% and enable prefix cache.

Devon (CS): Prompt set uploaded: /shared/hightide/hightide_onboard_prompts_v1.txt — pinged the customer for sign-off.

deploy-bot: Canary reporting: initial 100 canary requests — 95th latency avg 310ms, quality deltas within expected bounds. Continuing monitoring.

Maria (CS): Perfect. I'll update the renewal doc and send a short note to the renewal owner. If anything spikes we roll back. :thumbsup:
